title: feat(app-shell): approval request B1 build round: referenceVia record card, module-internal decision panel, routed request page (objectui#12045)
body:
Refs #12045 (B1 build round)
Clause-②: yes

The v18-independent build round of objectui#12045 (B1 of the approvals epic objectui#2763), under ruling `6079807016` (letter 乙) and claim amendments `6079939323`, `6080124489` (amendment 2) and `6081385696` (amendment 3). This PR does not close the card. The page-mount step stays open on the card's three `Blocked-by:` lines.

## What changed

1. **`referenceVia` pointer pairs draw A2's record card in the details grid** (amendment 2: the details face only).
   - `@object-ui/fields` owns the rule. `resolveRecordPointer(field, row)` returns `{ objectName, recordId }` (the new `RecordPointer` type) for a `text` field that declares a non-empty `referenceVia`, read from the row; otherwise it returns `null`. `RECORD_POINTER_CARD_TYPE` is the registry key a pair is drawn with. The package registers a default under it that draws the record id as text.
   - `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s `DetailSection` is the call site. It holds the row, reads `referenceVia` off the object field and draws the pair through the key.
   - `@object-ui/app-shell` registers `RecordPreviewCard` (A2) under the key with the existing `registerFieldRenderer`, from a side-effect module imported by `src/index.ts`. `fields` does not import app-shell.
   - Unchanged: `CellRendererProps`, `packages/types`, and the authorable keys.
2. **The decision panel, module-internal** (amendment 3, route B).
   - `packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx` draws A3's `DecisionProgressIndicator` from the request's served `decision_progress`, above `DeclaredActionsBar`. The bar shows `sys_approval_request`'s own declared actions at `record_section`, and decisions go through `ActionParamDialog`.
   - It reads the record context only and takes no authorable props. After a decision it invalidates the request record and its timeline on the data bus.
   - ⭐ **Moved to the page-mount step:** the `record:approval_decision` registration, its side-effect import from `src/index.ts`, its `known-schema-types.ts` line and its `@object-ui/types/zod` arm. They land together there, derived from objectstack-ai/objectstack#22472's v18 row.
   - Why: `packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` measured 361 refused namespaced keys against its pin of 360 once the type was registered. The gate forbids raising the pin. The pin stays at 360.
3. **A1 wired to the request page, and the timeline routed.**
   - **The file that picks the data source**, named before the edit: `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`. `DefaultAppContent` hands `useAdapter()` to the generic `:objectName/record/:recordId` route, and ObjectView forwards the same adapter to its drawer and split overlays.
   - app-shell cannot import the console's A1, so the console now declares the more specific route `sys_approval_request/record/:recordId` in `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`. It is passed only as `extraRoutes`. The route mounts the same `RecordDetailView` over `createApprovalRequestsDataSource({ host: adapter, scope: { kind: 'all' } })`.
   - In `apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.ts`, a `sys_approval_action` read whose `$filter` is exactly `{ request_id: ID }` reads `GET /approvals/requests/ID/actions`. The source applies the read's `$orderby` (the object-array form, by stored value), `$top` and `$skip` itself, and reports the whole timeline as `total`. It drops `$select` and `$expand`, and refuses any other parameter with `UNSUPPORTED_QUERY_PARAM`. Any other `sys_approval_action` read goes to the host unchanged.
4. **Narrow item, one condition:** on a request's own page, `RecordDetailView` passes no object name to `useRecordApprovals`, so the read of approvals opened on the request itself is not sent.

Docs: `packages/fields/README.md` and `content/docs/guide/fields.md` describe the pointer pair. Changeset: `.changeset/12045-approval-decision-panel.md`, with `@object-ui/fields` minor and app-shell, plugin-detail and console patch.

## Measurements

- **List cells:** A2 has no compact form (`RecordPreviewCard` has only the card). Under amendment 2 the list face is not in this round.
- **First-load bytes**, from `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`:
  - base `e97a0e2d` measured 3,239,763 B gzipped, and this head measured 3,243,943 B, so the closure grew by 4,180 B.
  - Removing only the pointer-card import from `src/index.ts` (a measured mutation, restored) gave 3,242,613 B, so the card costs 1,330 B.
  - The ceiling stays 3,281,467 B, which leaves 37,524 B of headroom. `pnpm check:eager-closure` printed "Console eager closure is 3167.9 KB gzipped across 290 of 2474 chunks (budget: 3204.6 KB, headroom: 36.6 KB)".
  - The field-renderer registry has no lazy path, and the panel is no longer imported, so nothing was made lazy.

## Tests (all at head `358ef618a` unless noted)

- New pins:
  - `packages/fields/src/__tests__/resolveRecordPointer-12045.test.tsx`;
  - `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.recordPointer-12045.test.tsx`, which pins `sys_approval_request.record_id` and the non-approval pair `sys_activity.source_id`;
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/record-preview/record-pointer-card-renderer.test.tsx`, the real `DetailSection` with A2's card for both pairs;
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/ApprovalDecisionPanel.test.tsx`;
  - `apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.timeline.test.ts`, the routed `sys_approval_action` pins;
  - `apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.decisionPage.test.tsx`.
- The last file mounts the real `RecordDetailView` over A1 with an in-repo slotted-page fixture: `actions` holds `record:approval_decision` (registered by the test itself, per amendment 3), `highlights` is empty, a `details` slot is authored, and `discussion` is empty. It asserts:
  - the tally and Approve and Reject, gated by the served `viewer`;
  - Approve opens `ActionParamDialog` with a comment and a multi-file input, POSTs `/api/v1/approvals/requests/ID/approve`, and re-reads the request;
  - `record_id` draws A2's card for the target invoice;
  - the timeline comes from the actions route;
  - no `/approvals/requests?object=sys_approval_request` read is sent;
  - the console route wins over the generic record route, with a control for another object.
- The census rows for the new registry key are in `cellRenderers.objectLiteral-8596` (fields) and `summaryChip.badgeFitCensus-8464` (plugin-detail; its fit-side count moved from 35 to 36).
- Suites:
  - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/ packages/plugin-detail/` at `f1499e95e`: Test Files 491 passed, 2 skipped; Tests 6393 passed, 15 skipped; exit 0. Route B touched neither package after that.
  - At `358ef618a`, the 45 `RecordDetailView*` suites, the panel, record-preview and approval-progress suites, `DeclaredActionsBar.test.tsx`, `apps/console/src/services/`, the two `AppContent` route suites, `packages/cli/`, the four script tests for known-schema-types and sideEffects, and the four new or edited fields and plugin-detail files: Test Files 90 passed (90), Tests 957 passed (957), exit 0.
  - The full app-shell suite was not run. It is CI's.
- Type-check, at `358ef618a`, exit 0 with 0 `error TS` each: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check`.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 16 touched TS files: 0 errors and 268 warnings. Two warnings are new, both `react-refresh/only-export-components`, the class of their neighbours: one for `resolveRecordPointer` in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, and one for `approvalRequestRoutes` beside `systemRoutes` in `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`.
- Gates, all exit 0 at `358ef618a`: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; see Acceptance notes), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:doc-types`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:self-import`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:eager-closure`, `check:sdui-registration-pins`, `node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs --check`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`. Locale packs are untouched, so the i18n pack gates do not apply.

**Reverse checks.** Each was run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with the prediction written first. The tool proved the anchor landed on disk, and that the restore left the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

- A1: the sibling column hard-coded to `object_name`. Predicted and observed: 2 red (the non-approval pair in fields and in plugin-detail); the approval pair stayed green.
- A2: the fields default not registered. 2 red (renderer of its own; the record id drawn as text).
- A3: the `DetailSection` branch disabled. 2 red (both probe pairs); the control and the default stayed green.
- A4: the app-shell card registration removed. 3 red (the registry answer and both cards); the control stayed green.
- A5: the timeline invalidation dropped. 1 red.
- A6: timeline routing disabled. 7 red (the routed and refusal cases); the 4 host controls stayed green.
- A7: ordering not applied. 1 red.
- A8: the narrow condition reverted. 1 red (the no-approvals-on-the-request assertion).
- A9: the console route path changed. 1 red; the control stayed green.
- A10: a registration re-added to the panel module. 1 red (the module-internal case). Its first attempt was refused by the tool, because the replacement contained the anchor, so nothing was mutated or measured. It was rerun with an anchor the replacement does not contain.

## Acceptance notes

- **Moved to the page-mount step (amendment 3):** the `record:approval_decision` registration, its barrel import, its known-types line and its zod arm.
- **Not in this round (amendment 2):** the list-cell face for pointer pairs. A label read per row is one request per row, and batching target-row reads per object rides B2.
- **For objectstack-ai/objectstack#22473's page:** `sys_approval_request` declares `record_id` in its `highlightFields`. The details grid hides every field a mounted `record:highlights` shows, and the synthesized Details tab is also handed the object's `highlightFields` as `hideFields`. So the card draws on the served page only if that page keeps `record_id` out of the highlights strip and authors the Details body: this PR's fixture uses `highlights: []` plus a `details` slot. Measured: with the synthesized strip, `record_id` sat in the highlights strip and no card was drawn.
- **Record surfaces covered:** the console route covers the request's record route. That is the surface a list row opens: the object has at least `RECORD_SURFACE_PAGE_THRESHOLD` authorable fields and declares no list-view `navigation`, so its record opens as a page. A drawer or split overlay inside ObjectView (only if a view authors one), and the record views embedded by `ObjectDataPage` and `InterfaceListPage`, still read through the adapter. The carrier is the page-mount step.
- **Pending changeset text:** `.changeset/12032-approval-requests-data-source.md` says "Nothing mounts the source yet". This PR mounts the source on the request's record route, so if both publish in one release the CHANGELOG states both. This PR leaves that changeset alone, because it is objectui#12032's declaration (`check-changeset-overwrite`). The seat decides whether to edit it.
- `$expand` is dropped on the timeline read. The route serves `actor_name` in place of an expansion, and the related list resolves lookup labels through its own fallback.
